proposal_rules.title: Add Minimal Cleanup Execution Rule
proposal_rules.hypothesis: When a user requests broad artifact cleanup with strict scope boundaries, a short preflight-and-verify rule reduces redundant reads/deletes and prevents recoverable delete errors.
proposal_rules.change: Add a harness rule for cleanup tasks: define allowed target directories first, run one bulk deletion per allowed directory, treat missing-path deletions as non-fatal, then run a single post-check confirming only requested artifact classes were removed and unrelated files were unchanged.

proposal_rules.title: Enforce Exact Capture Path Reuse
proposal_rules.hypothesis: Failures occur when agents create near-match directory names instead of reusing existing canonical buckets; explicit exact-path checks before completion will catch these typos.
proposal_rules.change: Add a rule requiring agents to enumerate existing destination directories before writing and to reuse exact names when a matching bucket already exists. Add a final verification step that compares required write targets to actual written paths and blocks completion on near-match typos.
